name: Pedro V of Kongo
contribution: A ruler of the throne of the Kingdom of Kongo and a member of the Kimpanzu house.

checks.lead: Pedro V Ntivila a Nkanga was a ruler of the throne of the Kingdom of Kongo and a member of the Kimpanzu house. He ruled Kongo from 1763 to 1764.
